tracks.title: Keystone
tracks.subtitle: Theme of Keystone
tracks.about: The main theme, for the stone that holds the arch. A guitar riff, then the theme low and steady, a chorus that lifts, a solo, and the theme again an octave higher with strings and organ behind it.

tracks.title: Dignity
tracks.subtitle: Made in the image of God
tracks.about: Hard rock for the worth of every person, which no state, market or machine can take away. Twin distorted guitars, a galloping verse and a brass-backed chorus.

tracks.title: Shoulder to Shoulder
tracks.subtitle: Solidarity
tracks.about: Fast, loud and together: a punk-rock anthem for solidarity, where the strong stand with the weak. Power chords all the way through, and a choir on every chorus.

tracks.title: Cry of the Poor
tracks.subtitle: The first claim on our care
tracks.about: A tolling bell, a heavy guitar and a pipe organ. The poor cry out, and the cry goes straight to those who can answer. In the last section it is answered, and the music turns from C minor to C major.

tracks.title: Working Hands
tracks.subtitle: Work is a vocation
tracks.about: Bright, driving rock with a Hammond-style organ and a brass section, for the dignity of work and a just wage. Every job done well builds the nation.

tracks.title: Hearth and Home
tracks.subtitle: A waltz for the family
tracks.about: A power ballad in waltz time for the family, the first school of love. It begins with piano and acoustic guitar, then the strings come in and the electric guitar takes the melody home.

tracks.title: Free to Believe
tracks.subtitle: Religious liberty for all
tracks.about: An open-hearted anthem for religious liberty. Faith cannot be forced, so every faith, and none, is free. Ringing guitars, piano and a choir that keeps rising.

tracks.title: Handed Down
tracks.subtitle: Tradition held in trust
tracks.about: A heavy, rolling groove with a rock organ, for the customs, crafts and faith our parents gave us. We keep what is good and hand it on.

tracks.title: Town, District, Nation
tracks.subtitle: Every level in its place
tracks.about: One melody played as a round. The piano is the town; the strings answer a bar later, an octave lower, as the district; the guitar joins two bars later as the nation. Then the whole band rises together.

tracks.title: Pilgrims
tracks.subtitle: Strangers made at home
tracks.about: Folk rock for newcomers who take up the nation's language, laws and customs and are welcomed as equals. Acoustic guitar and piano at first, then the band and strings join in.

tracks.title: Care for Creation
tracks.subtitle: Stewards of the earth
tracks.about: A slow, wide build for the earth we hold in trust for our children. Clean guitar and organ open it like a sunrise, and it ends with every instrument at full height.

tracks.title: The Common Good
tracks.subtitle: Everyone's good, together
tracks.about: A stadium anthem for the measure of every law and every institution: the good of the whole nation and of every person in it. Big riff, big chorus, brass and piano.

tracks.title: Stone by Stone
tracks.subtitle: Finale
tracks.about: The Keystone theme returns in D major with the whole band, a pipe organ and a choir: the common good, built stone by stone.
